title: India's ports just moved a record 915 million tonnes of cargo
sources: PIB (Press Information Bureau, Government of India), 2026 - Major Ports FY2025-26 cargo data
IBEF, 2026 - Major ports handle record 915 million tonnes cargo in FY26, surpass target
PSU Watch / DD News, 2026 - Ports Minister statement on FY26 cargo performance
caption:
India's ports just moved more cargo in one year than ever before. And they beat their own target doing it.

India's Major Ports handled 915.17 million tonnes of cargo this financial year - up 7.06% year-on-year, beating the government's own 904 million tonne target. Cargo on India's national waterways grew even faster, up nearly 50% year on year.

Deendayal Port and Paradip Port led the pack, each moving over 150 million tonnes on their own. India has now earmarked over $80 billion for port infrastructure through 2035, under the Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047 framework.

Ports don't trend on social media. But every export, every import, every factory that depends on either one runs through them first.

Sources: PIB, IBEF, PSU Watch/DD News (2026)
